# `webmcp/valid-event-name`

**ESLint-only rule** · `problem` · in `recommended`

ModelContext fires toolchange, toolactivated and toolcancel; a listener on document.modelContext for any other tool* event never runs.

This rule has no counterpart in the `@swissspidy/webmcp-lint` engine: it reads the source, and what it catches does not survive to runtime for a page rule to see.

## Configuring it

```js
// eslint.config.js
{ rules: { "webmcp/valid-event-name": "warn" } }
```
